source.title: My Account Is Up Over 1,000% in 17 Days...

market_reconstruction.interpretation: The historical SIP path is consistent with the recap's report of entering around the $6 break and receiving a roughly $6.30 fill seconds later; it does not prove the human order's exact send/receive timestamps.

research_notes: This benchmark label is retrospective ground truth and must never be supplied to a policy replaying July 9, 2026.
The official one-minute 11:32 UTC bar compresses the second micro pullback, breakout through $6, surge to $7.49 and rejection into one bar.
Derived ten-second bars were validated by reconstructing complete minute bars from SIP trades with zero OHLCV difference versus Alpaca's official minute bars in the complete reference minutes.
